responsibility: Provides the instruction scheduling description for the IBM POWER5 processor. It models the processor’s dispatch slots, integer units, load/store paths, floating-point units, branch and CR resources, and their latencies for loads, updates, arithmetic, multiplies/divides, compares, stores, and synchronization operations, giving GCC a POWER5-specific scheduler cost and hazard model distinct from neighboring POWER4 and newer POWER6 descriptions.
